Indian government sites (fssai.gov.in, cdsco.gov.in, consumeraffairs.nic.in, indiacode, egazette) were blocked by this session's network policy. Legal citations were confirmed from web-search text that names the provision. "verified": true means the provision and its substance were confirmed that way; the text was not read from the gazette.

Shop-level credentials (seller_fssai_licence_no, drug_licence_no, clinical_establishment_reg_no, pcpndt_registration_no, aerb_licence_no) are listed so each sub-category shows its obligations. They belong on the shop profile (R5 statutory layer) and are never in basic_form.

composition currently maps to catalog_path attributes.generic, but in the Jan Aushadhi snapshot attributes.generic is a boolean (is a generic medicine). R1 defines composition (text) and generic (boolean) separately, so the catalog_path needs fixing.

schedule_drug is a boolean in the current form. R1 makes it an enum (OTC / G / H / H1 / X / NDPS / AYUSH) because H1 (register) and X (Form 20F licence) need different handling. This is a type change to approve.
specialty and language are text in the current forms. R1 makes them multi_enum with open values, because hospitals list many specialties and caregivers speak several languages.
